description: What appears in the Playdate system menu (max 3 items) and the pause image alongside it. Consumed by the launcher stage.
prompt_template:
Given prior picks (especially gameplay and save styles):
{prior_picks}

Generate {count} system menu setups. Each setup is a complete spec for the 3 menu item slots plus a pause image direction.

Pause image is shown on the LEFT 200px of the 400x240 screen while the system menu is open on the right. Plan composition with that constraint.

menu_items: array of exactly 1, 2, or 3 entries. Each has:
  - slot: 1, 2, or 3
  - kind: action | checkmark | options
  - title: short string (≤20 chars)
  - action_or_options: for action a callback function name (string); for checkmark the initial bool; for options an array of strings

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the hardware menu option below per the user feedback. Stay within 3 menu items; keep slot numbers unique.

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.pause_image_intent: string — what shows on the left 200px next to the system menu
option_schema.pause_image_prompt: string — image gen prompt for the pause image (1-bit, ~200x240 effective)
option_schema.auto_lock_disabled_scenes: array of scene ids that should call playdate.setAutoLockDisabled(true)
